captions.detailed: A miniature brick campanile tower featuring a tall, dark-red rectangular shaft on a light-grey concrete base. The top section consists of a belfry with horizontal louvers on all four sides, capped by a pyramid-shaped terracotta roof. Inside the belfry, a small bell is suspended from a dark yoke, designed to swing along a horizontal revolute joint.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a brick campanile tower with a tall rectangular shaft, a louvered belfry level, and an internal bell mounted on a horizontal revolute joint so it can swing.
captions.factory: Construct the tower base and shaft using Box primitives. Create the belfry level by extruding a hollowed-out square profile and cutting rectangular openings for the louvers, which are made of thin horizontal plates. Model the roof as a pyramid using a lofted or extruded draft. For the bell assembly, construct a yoke and a bell shape from revolved profiles, and mount them inside the belfry using a revolute joint aligned with the horizontal axis.
